environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in VPC subnet with ALB forwarding traffic directly to container on port 8443. Task role has cloudhsm:DescribeClusters permission. Container image based on python:3.11-slim with Flask 2.3.x. ALB listener on port 443 with TLS termination, forwarding to target group. No additional request filtering or inspection layers. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on ALB, and ALB-to-task on 8443.

config.alb_config: internet-facing, TLS termination only, no WAF attached
config.security_groups: ALB: inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0; Task: inbound 8443/tcp from ALB SG
config.hsm_config: CloudHSM cluster in same VPC, key CKA_EXTRACTABLE=FALSE, CKA_SENSITIVE=TRUE
